purpose: Generate a visually designed slide region, preserve generation knowledge, understand the result, and reconstruct a clean editable PowerPoint slide.

rules: Exact source content remains authoritative.
Documents, images, data files, user notes, and assets are normalized into source atoms with provenance and locators.
Instructions are classified as hard constraints, soft constraints, or preferences. Active hard constraints remain mandatory downstream.
Conflicting or ambiguous hard constraints trigger user resolution instead of silent weakening.
The plan describes message, hierarchy, relationships, reading logic, supporting information, and layout-agnostic visual intent.
Coordinates and component layouts are omitted unless explicitly requested by the user.
Visual references are whole-page visual precedents and are never layouts to copy.
Exact upstream canonical assets take priority.
Fallback pictograms are selected as a coherent semantic set.
Asset IDs, provenance, canonical paths, descriptions, and intrinsic geometry are retained.
Long-term system settings and run-resolved decisions are shown separately.
Framework-proposed values are distinguished from user-provided values.
Header and footer geometry comes from deck design configuration while slide-specific chrome content is resolved for the current run.
Mandatory assets, source coverage, hard constraints, unresolved assumptions, and route decisions are visible before approval.
External image generation is released only for an approved package fingerprint.
Header and footer regions are excluded from generation.
The title remains inside the generation region and follows configured treatment.
The image model owns the visual composition of the body.
Slide understanding and Editable reconstruction implementation details are excluded from the image prompt.
Replaceable icons are rendered as semantic placeholders inside authoritative rectangular slots.
Only material failures are reported.
The reviewer returns the smallest preservation-first edit delta.
The main orchestrator appends authoritative canvas, title, content, style, relationship, and asset invariants.
Semantic mapping identifies meaningful authored entities, hierarchy, relationships, grouping, and likely z-order.
OpenCV performs deterministic measurement and SAM 2 is used selectively for irregular filled boundaries.
OCR words, masks, contours, edge fragments, and generated icon glyphs remain evidence unless they represent an independently authored object.
Exact upstream text and asset candidates are used to resolve ambiguous pixels.
Known elements use native PowerPoint objects, exact source content, canonical assets, and maintained reusable elements.
New or redesigned elements use semantic decomposition, PowerPoint primitives and connectors, fitted geometry when needed, and raster fallback only when necessary.
Deck chrome is applied deterministically after reconstruction.
A bounded reasoning-guided normalization pass improves repeated alignment, spacing, icon placement, connector routing, and peer typography without redesigning the slide.
Microsoft PowerPoint for Mac is the canonical renderer for typography and final compatibility.
Every emitted object must map to a reconstruction unit.
Evidence records never emit independent PowerPoint objects.

guidance_profiles.purpose: Define how a selected deck type reasons and communicates without owning its deck design system or reconstruction mechanics.
guidance_profiles.selection_scope: deck with optional explicit slide override
guidance_profiles.inheritance: base profile plus selected profile through recursive configuration merge

intake.normalization_output: source atoms with material ID, locator, authority, provenance, and extraction confidence
intake.hard_constraint_policy: mandatory through semantic planning, generation, review, reconstruction, and validation
intake.conflict_policy: resolve through explicit precedence or request user direction
intake.traceability_policy: content-bearing semantic units and reconstructed objects cite source atoms

retrieval.visual_reference_mode: metadata-first semantic retrieval with visual loading after ranking
retrieval.icon_mode: semantic metadata retrieval with exact upstream assets first and coherent set-level substitution
retrieval.known_component_mode: semantic metadata retrieval before generation and entity-level requery after Slide understanding

text.default_object: one native textbox per logical authored block
text.fit_objective: largest readable size that fits without overflow and preserves hierarchy
text.peer_normalization: jointly solve common size and style by semantic role

icons.slot_surface_policy: retain when visibly designed, remove when temporary placement scaffolding

connectors.terminal_segment: straight when the final junction and destination anchor share an axis

images.fallback: one Slide understanding screenshot crop embedded as one picture object

tables.fallback: aligned native shapes and textboxes when native table limitations prevent faithful output

charts.preferred_route: native editable chart from authoritative upstream data
charts.fallback: editable shape composition when no authoritative chart data exists

z_order_and_grouping.source: semantic ownership plus measured overlap evidence
z_order_and_grouping.grouping_rule: create meaningful PowerPoint groups only when they improve editability or preserve repeated structures

forbidden: outer textbox expansion to solve overflow
normalization.geometry_source: generated geometry is a strong initial condition that may receive small validated translations
normalization.movement_policy: translate the complete semantic group while preserving width, height, internal geometry, and z-order
normalization.acceptance_policy: apply only high-confidence proposals that materially reduce alignment error within movement bounds and pass post-change validation
normalization.rollback_policy: reject or roll back any proposal that violates a hard constraint

certification_boundaries.reasoning_and_vision: The Agent host supplies semantic reasoning and vision by default. OpenAI-compatible structured providers remain available where configured.
certification_boundaries.visual_reference_retrieval: The package seeds three reference pages and supports larger metadata-indexed local collections.
certification_boundaries.icon_retrieval: The package seeds a licensed Tabler subset and supports additional indexed SVG collections.
certification_boundaries.known_components: Only components with a supported editable implementation may be selected. Unsupported candidates remain retrieval evidence and use another reconstruction route.
certification_boundaries.constructor: PptxGenJS is the single certified portable constructor backend.
certification_boundaries.native_validation: Microsoft PowerPoint rendering is an optional explicit validation capability on macOS.
